description: Knowledge-graph connections of an entity id (e.g. topic:gpu-scheduling, project:vllm, technology:ebpf) with relation type, origin (explicit/extracted/curated/inferred) and evidence. Inferred and extracted links are likely connections, not confirmed facts.

configuration.query: FROM conference_relationships | WHERE source_id == ?entity_id OR target_id == ?entity_id | KEEP source_id, type, target_id, origin, confidence, evidence | SORT confidence DESC | LIMIT 30

entity_id.description: Entity id such as topic:gpu-scheduling or project:vllm
